title: Timeline Weaver
description:
An authorized forensics lab reconstructed a fictional incident timeline from multiple sources:

```
02:13:40 DNS   files.rabbit.lab -> 10.20.0.44
02:14:02 AUTH  login OK user=analyst src=10.20.0.33
02:14:37 PROXY GET /pack.zip 200 bytes=48211 client=10.20.0.33
02:15:01 PROC  curl -s http://files.rabbit.lab/pack.zip -o /tmp/pack.zip
02:15:44 AUTH  sudo user=analyst cmd=/usr/bin/unzip
```

One internal source address initiated the download and performed the later privilege escalation.
objective: Submit the internal source IP as HC{ip}.

hints.text: Correlate the AUTH, PROXY and PROC lines by timestamp.
The DNS server is not the client that downloaded the archive.
